ScanVerdictPayload.description: The signed claim: what was examined, by what, with what outcome.

agentId.description: Stable identity of the agent whose traffic was scanned, when it proved one. None means the caller was unattested, which is a fact about the call and not a missing field.
agentId.title: Agentid

contentBinding.description: sha256 hex binding this verdict to the exact bytes that were scanned, via compute_content_binding(). The content itself is never carried.
contentBinding.title: Contentbinding

detector.description: Name of the detector that produced the finding, e.g. 'regex_egress'.
detector.title: Detector

detectorKind.description: Whether 'clean' means no rule matched, or below a threshold.
detectorKind.title: Detectorkind

detectorVersion.description: Version of that detector. Bumped whenever its rule set or weights change: a finding trend that crosses a silent version boundary is not a trend.
detectorVersion.title: Detectorversion

direction.description: egress = the agent produced it; ingress = the environment did.
direction.title: Direction

disposition.description: What the gateway did: recorded it, or refused the call.
disposition.title: Disposition

finding.description: Category of what was found, e.g. 'secret.aws_access_key_id'. None means clean. NEVER the matched bytes, the offsets, or any excerpt: a record that quoted the secret it flagged would leak exactly what it exists to protect.
finding.title: Finding

requestBinding.description: The A2A attestation's request_binding for the scanned call, when the call carried one. Identical bytes in both documents are what lets a verifier prove the verdict and the attestation describe the same request. Compute via warlog_spec.a2a.compute_request_binding.
requestBinding.title: Requestbinding

scannedAt.description: When the content was examined (aware UTC).
scannedAt.title: Scannedat

scoreMilli.description: The model's score in thousandths (873 = 0.873), for a model detector. None for a deterministic one, because a rule that matched has no probability and writing 1000 would be a fabricated measurement on the surface that decides a refusal. Integer, not float: see the module docstring on canonical bytes.
scoreMilli.title: Scoremilli

surface.description: Where in the agent's traffic the bytes came from.
surface.title: Surface

tenantRef.description: Opaque tenant identifier the scanned traffic belonged to.
tenantRef.title: Tenantref

thresholdMilli.description: The threshold the score was compared against, in thousandths. Meaningless without a score.
thresholdMilli.title: Thresholdmilli

verdictId.description: Stable identifier for this verdict. Present for identity, not for anti-replay: two identical findings on identical content would otherwise be byte-identical, and an operator could not tell one event from two.
verdictId.title: Verdictid

ScanVerdictPayload.title: ScanVerdictPayload

ScanVerdictSignature.description:
Detached signature envelope for a :class:`ScanVerdictPayload`.

A third sibling of :class:`~warlog_spec.provider_abi.AuditAttestation` and
:class:`~warlog_spec.a2a.A2ASignature` rather than a shared base class, and
that is deliberate. Each artifact owning its own wire type is what stops a
change made for one from silently altering another's canonical bytes; a
common base would couple three signature formats that must be free to
diverge. RFC-0005 set this precedent for the same reason.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Ed25519 only in v1 (RFC-0004 asymmetric path).
algorithm.title: Algorithm

canonicalizationFormat.description: Canonical-bytes format identifier, decoupled from the payload's spec_version.
canonicalizationFormat.title: Canonicalizationformat

keyId.description: Reference resolving to the Ed25519 public key of the GATEWAY that signed this verdict (RFC-0004 semantics). Not the detector's key: the detector reports, the enforcement point attests.
keyId.title: Keyid

signatureValue.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature over the domain-separated canonical payload bytes (64 bytes -> 128 hex).
signatureValue.title: Signaturevalue

ScanVerdictSignature.title: ScanVerdictSignature
